headline: Solana Funding Turns Negative At 0.005 Percent As Shorts Pay Longs
narrative: Solana perpetual funding turned negative at 0.005 percent, so shorts are paying longs on that pipe and the latest rate marks the short side crowded. The newest print is negative against a recent average of 0.0041 percent and a recent peak of 0.01 percent. Bitcoin funding is calm at 0.004 percent and ether funding is calm at 0.001 percent, while the Solana long-short ratio stands at 3.1, the 97.5th percentile of its own 30-day range.
author: jordan
